title: Creamy mushroom pasta
text: Creamy mushroom pasta Rich, silky and comforting pasta dinner. Ingredients: pasta, mushroom, oat cream, olive oil Cuisine: italian-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 20 minutes. Cook the pasta. Fry sliced mushrooms in olive oil, add oat cream and simmer. Toss with the pasta.

title: Fresh chickpea salad
text: Fresh chickpea salad A light salad with crunchy vegetables and bright lemon. Ingredients: chickpea, cucumber, tomato, lemon, olive oil Cuisine: mediterranean-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 10 minutes. Drain canned chickpeas. Dice cucumber and tomato. Toss with lemon juice and olive oil.

title: Creamy chicken rice
text: Creamy chicken rice A hearty chicken dinner with a rich cream sauce. Ingredients: chicken, rice, cream Cuisine: international Dietary tags: none Cooking time: 30 minutes. Cook the rice. Pan-fry diced chicken until cooked through, add cream and simmer. Serve over rice.

title: Coconut chickpea curry
text: Coconut chickpea curry A warming, creamy and gently spicy curry. Ingredients: chickpea, coconut milk, spinach, onion, curry powder Cuisine: indian-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 25 minutes. Fry chopped onion with curry powder. Add canned chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer and stir in spinach.

title: Smoky black bean tacos
text: Smoky black bean tacos Smoky beans with crisp cabbage and lime. Ingredients: black bean, tortilla, cabbage, lime, smoked paprika Cuisine: mexican-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 18 minutes. Warm canned beans with smoked paprika. Fill warm tortillas and top with shredded cabbage and lime.

title: Lemon herb couscous
text: Lemon herb couscous A fluffy, tangy side with fresh parsley. Ingredients: couscous, lemon, parsley, olive oil Cuisine: mediterranean-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 15 minutes. Prepare couscous according to the package. Fluff and mix with lemon, chopped parsley and oil.

title: Tomato lentil stew
text: Tomato lentil stew A hearty tomato stew with earthy lentils. Ingredients: lentil, tomato, carrot, onion Cuisine: international Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 35 minutes. Soften diced onion and carrot. Add canned tomatoes and rinsed red lentils with water and simmer until tender.

title: Ginger tofu stir-fry
text: Ginger tofu stir-fry A bright, savory dinner with crisp broccoli. Ingredients: tofu, broccoli, ginger, soy sauce, oil Cuisine: east-asian-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 22 minutes. Brown cubed tofu in oil. Stir-fry broccoli and ginger, then return tofu and add soy sauce.

title: Apple cinnamon oats
text: Apple cinnamon oats Warm, soft breakfast oats with sweet apple. Ingredients: oats, apple, cinnamon, water Cuisine: international Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 12 minutes. Simmer oats in water with diced apple and cinnamon until soft.

title: Roasted cauliflower bowls
text: Roasted cauliflower bowls Nutty roasted cauliflower with fluffy quinoa. Ingredients: cauliflower, quinoa, tahini, lemon, olive oil Cuisine: mediterranean-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 40 minutes. Roast cauliflower in olive oil at 220°C until tender. Cook quinoa and serve with tahini and lemon.

title: Peanut cucumber noodles
text: Peanut cucumber noodles Cold, tangy noodles with crisp cucumber. Ingredients: noodles, peanut butter, cucumber, lime, soy sauce Cuisine: east-asian-inspired Dietary tags: vegan Cooking time: 16 minutes. Cook and cool wheat noodles. Whisk peanut butter, lime and soy sauce with water. Toss with cucumber.

title: Salmon and dill potatoes
text: Salmon and dill potatoes A light, herby dinner with flaky salmon. Ingredients: salmon, potato, dill, lemon Cuisine: nordic-inspired Dietary tags: none Cooking time: 32 minutes. Boil potatoes until tender. Bake salmon until cooked through and serve with dill and lemon.
